commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<empty>}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<empty>}"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain

HEAD_REF="issue-2009-cloud-implement-runs-red-the-1621-ruff-gate-on-a"
CO_ERR=$( { git fetch origin "$HEAD_REF" && git checkout "$HEAD_REF"; } 2>&1 1>/dev/null ) || true
LANDED=no; [ -n "$HEAD_REF" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$HEAD_REF" ] && LANDED=yes
echo "CO_ERR=$CO_ERR"
echo "LANDED=$LANDED"
git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD

RUN_URL="https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/actions/runs/33020939835"
PR_NUMBER=2021
if ! PR_BODY=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/2021" --jq '.body' 2>/dev/null); then
  PR_BODY=""
  echo "::warning::prflow resume: could not read PR #2021 body (gh api read failed); PR-body run-link refresh skipped" >&2
fi
echo "len=${#PR_BODY}"
case "$PR_BODY" in
  *"[View run]("*) echo "has-view-run-line=yes" ;;
  *) echo "has-view-run-line=no" ;;
esac
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/2021" --jq '.body' > /tmp/prbody.txt 2>/tmp/prbody.err; echo "rc=$?"; wc -c /tmp/prbody.txt; grep -c "\[View run\](" /tmp/prbody.txt

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
